words.gloss: even if he tries to appease

literal: Even if he appeases her, she will grow angry, saying, 'To other women also, you behave with this same nature!'
translation: Even when he tries to appease and reassure her of his love, she grows angry, saying, 'This is exactly how you must behave with other women too!'
modern: தலைவன் தன் அன்பை வெளிப்படுத்தித் தலைவியைச் சமாதானப்படுத்த முயன்றாலும், 'மற்றப் பெண்களிடமும் நீங்கள் இப்படித்தான் நடந்து கொள்வீர்கள்' என்று கூறி அவள் கோபப்படுகிறாள்.
explanation: This couplet portrays a delicate moment of lovers' tiff where the heroine's intense love manifests as playful jealousy. When the hero tries to comfort and appease her, she becomes angry instead of being pacified. She suspects his gentle, loving behavior is not unique to her, accusing him of using the same charming manners to win over other women. Her anger is a reflection of her deep desire for his exclusive affection, turning even his attempts at reconciliation into a source of sweet dispute.
